title: QA automation engineer vs manual-QA keyword trap
description: A 4-year QA automation engineer (Selenium, Cypress, Python, CI pipelines) evaluated against 8 postings: a senior SDET gap target, a mobile-leaning SET role, a clerical manual-QA documentation trap stuffed with automation keywords, a marginal build/release role, and four distractors.
rationale: j3 is the keyword-trap family member: a clerical test-case documentation role whose posting is saturated with the resume's exact automation keywords (Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, pytest, TestRail) yet explicitly states 'no programming or automation work involved' — the duties are manual transcription and spreadsheet data entry, so it is grade 0 despite heavy lexical overlap. TF-IDF should over-rank it; the hybrid matcher should not. j1 is the gap target: strong overlap on Selenium, Cypress, Python, pytest and CI pipelines justifies grade 3, while Playwright and k6/JMeter performance testing (required) plus TypeScript and AWS (preferred) are genuine annotated gaps. j2 stays at grade 2 because the mobile emphasis (Appium, BrowserStack) is outside the resume while the web-automation core matches. j4 probes the graded boundary: real Jenkins/Python/Docker overlap but the job family is release engineering, not QA.

resume.summary: QA automation engineer with 4 years of experience building end-to-end and API test suites in Selenium, Cypress, and Python. Owns test infrastructure end to end: framework design, CI integration, flaky-test triage, and release gating.

experience.title: QA Automation Engineer
bullets: Built a Cypress end-to-end suite of 320 scenarios covering the billing and onboarding flows, cutting the regression cycle from 3 days to 4 hours
Parallelized the Selenium WebDriver grid across Docker containers, reducing nightly suite runtime by 60%
Wired test suites into Jenkins and GitHub Actions as merge-blocking release gates for 5 services
Introduced a flaky-test quarantine workflow that reduced false CI failures by 70%

bullets: Wrote a pytest-based REST API test suite of 450 cases against the claims-processing backend
Migrated a 200-case manual regression checklist to Selenium WebDriver with the Page Object Model

bullets: Parses JUnit XML across pipeline runs and scores tests by failure intermittency
Adopted by 3 internal teams to drive weekly flaky-test triage

jobs.raw_text:
Senior QA Automation Engineer (SDET) — Streamvale (Remote, US)

Streamvale's video platform serves 8M viewers on live event nights, and our release gates have to hold under that pressure. We are hiring a Senior SDET to own test automation across web and API layers.

What you will do:
- Own end-to-end regression suites in Cypress and Playwright
- Extend our Selenium WebDriver grid and migrate legacy suites to Playwright
- Gate releases through pytest-based API checks wired into Jenkins and GitHub Actions pipelines
- Build load and performance test scenarios for peak live-event traffic

Requirements: Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Python, Playwright, and performance testing with k6 or JMeter. 5+ years in software test automation, 1+ years owning performance or load testing. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Nice to have: TypeScript, AWS, contract testing with Pact.

Software Engineer in Test — Appwave Mobile (Hybrid, Atlanta GA)

Appwave builds a loyalty-rewards app used by 40 grocery chains. Our web dashboard is well covered; our mobile clients are not, and we want an SET to close that gap.

You will maintain and extend our Cypress suite for the merchant dashboard, stand up mobile UI automation for iOS and Android with Appium, and write REST API tests that run on every pull request. You will also help triage device-farm failures and keep our BrowserStack runs healthy.

Requirements: Cypress, JavaScript, Appium, and REST API testing. 3+ years in test automation. Bonus: Python and BrowserStack experience. We value engineers who treat test code as production code.

jobs.raw_text:
QA Test Case Documentation Coordinator — Orbis Insurance Services (Onsite, Hartford CT)

Our engineering group runs large Selenium WebDriver and Cypress automation suites, and the paperwork around them has fallen behind. We need a detail-oriented coordinator to document test cases for our Selenium suite, transcribe steps from Cypress and pytest scripts into plain-English test cases, and keep our TestRail library tidy.

This is a documentation and data-entry role — no programming or automation work is involved. You will manually execute scripted checklists during release weeks, log results in Excel spreadsheets that reference Selenium and Cypress spec names, and file tickets for the automation team.

Requirements: manual test case writing, Microsoft Excel, TestRail data entry, and strong attention to detail. 1+ years in a clerical, documentation, or manual QA support role.

Build & Release Engineer — Foundrix (Remote, US)

Foundrix ships an embedded-analytics SDK to 200+ enterprise customers, and every release crosses 14 build variants. We are hiring a Build & Release Engineer to own that machinery.

You will maintain Jenkins pipelines and shared Groovy libraries, manage artifact promotion through Artifactory, script release tooling in Python, and keep our Docker-based build images current. You will coordinate release trains with engineering leads and cut hotfix branches under pressure.

Requirements: Jenkins, Groovy, Python, Docker, and Artifactory. 3+ years in build, release, or DevOps engineering. Bonus: Bazel and macOS codesigning experience.

Android Engineer — Lumora Apps (Hybrid, Austin TX)

Lumora builds a sleep-tracking app with 2M monthly users. We are hiring an Android Engineer to lead our Jetpack Compose migration.

You will build new tracking and insights screens in Jetpack Compose, maintain the existing XML-based UI during migration, and profile battery and startup performance on low-end devices. You will work closely with our designer and backend team in two-week cycles.

Requirements: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, and Room. 3+ years shipping Android apps to the Play Store. Bonus: Wear OS and Bluetooth Low Energy experience.

Brightline sells workforce-scheduling software to mid-market retailers, and our CSM team owns everything after the contract is signed. We are hiring a Customer Success Manager for a book of 45 accounts.

You will run onboarding and quarterly business reviews, monitor product adoption and health scores, drive renewals and expansion conversations, and channel customer feedback to product management.
